app.title: Application
app.autostartHint: Start Tessera when you log in (minimized to the tray)
app.upToDate: You are on the latest version.

confirm.deactivate: Deactivate {name}? They will not be able to sign in.

hint.login: create an OAuth application (Admin → Applications, or in a group), scope {scope}, Redirect URI: {redirect}. {toggle} shows the button on the sign-in screen.
hint.sync: set a {token} (a service account PAT, scope {api}) — the whole sync runs under it, with no personal user tokens. Issues map onto accounts by OAuth identity (whoever signed in through GitLab), not by who owns the integration token.

field.serviceTokenSub: A service account PAT; sync without personal tokens
field.sudoSub: issues and write-back go out as the acting user; the service token then has to be an admin PAT (scope api + sudo). Keep this OFF if GitLab or Tessera is reachable from an external network

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.hint: In-app notifications (the bell, the mobile app) always arrive. This is where you configure external delivery channels and the rules that route notifications into them.

channels.title: Channels
channels.permDenied: Notifications are blocked in the browser — enable them in the site settings.
channels.permNeeded: Browser permission for notifications is required.

routes.title: Routing rules
routes.hint: Rules are checked top to bottom — the first match wins. The notification goes to its channels (or nowhere, if the rule mutes it).
routes.empty: No rules — external channels receive nothing

schedule.title: Deadlines and reminders
schedule.hint: When to notify about task due dates. A single task can override this — click its date on the card. Quiet hours keep the frequency from turning into spam.
schedule.dueEnabled: Notify me when a task deadline is approaching
schedule.digestHint: Notifications inside the window are merged into one message per channel — less noise during bursts.
schedule.quietHint: During this window external notifications are held back and arrive once it ends. In-app ones (the bell) always arrive. Times are in your time zone.
schedule.quietHintTz: During this window external notifications are held back and arrive once it ends. In-app ones (the bell) always arrive. Times are in your time zone ({tz}).

confirm.channelUsedIn: It is used by {n} rule — it will stop delivering to this channel. | It is used by {n} rules — they will stop delivering to this channel.
